name: Ishibutai Kofun
heritage: Special Historic Site; Historic Site of Japan
type: archaeological site; kofun; horizontal stone chamber
text: Ishibutai kofun (石舞台古墳)  is a Kofun period burial mound, located in the village of Asuka, Nara in the Kansai region of Japan. The tumulus was designated a National Historic Site of Japan in 1935. In 1954 the designation was elevated to a Special Historic Sites (特別史跡, tokubetsu shiseki),  The kofun is also known as the Ishibutoya (石太屋) Kofun.

depictions.name: Ishibutai Kofun
depictions.text: Ishibutai Kofun is a kofun east of Asuka Rocks in Yamato, Japan.
